and.name: Model_Federation
and.description: The root feature representing the Model Federation approach, focusing on enabling diverse systems, models, and organizations to work together through interoperability, reusability, and composability.

and.name: Structural
and.description: Covers the artefacts, links, and structural features of Model Federation, including model composition, graph structure, formalism, domain, and technological context.

and.name: Components
and.description: Software components and architectural elements that constitute the infrastructure of the federation.

and.name: Connectors
and.description: Software components that connect individual models to the multi-model, allowing controlled information exchange between models.

feature.name: Technological_Connectors
feature.description: Mechanisms offered to establish a dynamic link between the virtual model and the technological models. Trace: [Article_8.pdf::chunk::42]

feature.name: Repository

feature.name: Model_Registry

feature.name: Openflexo

feature.name: Part_Library

feature.name: Tracing_Tools

feature.name: Service_Exposure_Libraries

feature.name: Diagnostics_Tool

feature.name: Requirements_Specifier

feature.name: Jira

feature.name: CAD_Drawing_Tools

feature.name: CORE

feature.name: GENESYS
feature.description: A toolsuite that models a system domain mainly focusing on its functional requirements towards offering support for verification, validation, and accreditation (VV&A). Trace: [Article_7.pdf §chunk::21]

feature.name: Solver
